standard-dialogue-after-meat-and-great.player: Had any more minotaur problems recently?

standard-dialogue-after-meat-and-great.npc: Not since you killed that one. The beastmaster reckons there was a problem with it imprinting. Happens from time to time.
Yup. They're meant to imprint on the beastmaster as soon as they're born, but this one seemingly didn't. As I say, it sometimes happens.

standard-dialogue-after-meat-and-great.player: I see. Well, hopefully I don't find myself coming up against any more rogue minotaurs.
